scenarios.title: Unsafe query construction
scenarios.objective: Identify why concatenating untrusted input into SQL is unsafe.
scenarios.expected_observation: The vulnerable example places the input inside the SQL statement; the fixed example keeps it in a parameter tuple.
scenarios.verification: Compare statement text and parameters; do not connect to an external database.

scenarios.title: Output encoding
scenarios.objective: Identify the difference between raw HTML output and encoded output.
scenarios.expected_observation: The vulnerable example preserves markup; the fixed example HTML-encodes it.

scenarios.title: Object-level authorization
scenarios.objective: Verify that record ownership is enforced.
scenarios.expected_observation: The vulnerable example returns Bob's synthetic record to Alice; the fixed example denies access.
scenarios.verification: Use only the synthetic records embedded in app.py.
